lines.english: he struck, and Ge was victorious
the following: In the reign of my husband
I am a amku-demon and I have gone to him.
he created them, and the kabu-offerings of the heavens

lines.atf: ki#-is,#-ru3 sza a-nim im-qu2-ut a-na s,i-ri-ia
lines.english: the snare of the east fell, to my yoke
he had conquered, and above me
he gave him, and his wife he did not marry.
Uruk, the land who reveres him,
he is a thief, he is a thief, he is a thief,
I called him, and I sent him to your protection.
the mother of Ge, the one who sustains all
favored by Ge, who like the mouth
he shall swear in a scepter and
You see him and you are like a woman.
he is a thief, he is a thief, he is a thief,
he shall release him, he shall return, and
you will give him to my yoke.
he smote me, he saw the other.
I saw that one, in a street,
he is a frightened one, and
ainum, the second one, his foundations
I saw him and I became frightened.
I prayed to him and like a wife
I am a slanderer of his own
I re-established it and established it for him.
the mother of Ge, who resides in all
the god Ge which you saw the man
you speak like a pure wife.
Because he is constantly afraid, he is with you.
he shall be praised by Ge.
Enkidu, who dwells in the midst of the quay
the base of her body he smote, her limbs he smote
Enkidu has left, wherever he wishes
he became frightened by the amma demon.
the arimtum-priestess her mouth performed, and
I will go to you, Enkidu, like a god,
you have been able to seize the yoke.
to the Ellim temple, the residence of the Anu
Enkidu, may his life be long!
to Eanna, its name is Anum.
And you, like a weak one,
Come, live! In the reed fence
she heard her word, she received her message;
with me he shall not raise him
like a god he gave him,
to the throne of the heavens
In its place they received a tribute from Riya.
And he, Enkidu, his offspring, is a aduma
with a seized man, and he has seized him, and he will recover.
With the sacrificials, he has sinned against him.
(and) a sealed document of the natû-priest
they placed a libation bowl before him.
he struck, and he has left
the armtum-priestess her mouth performed, and
beer for a gift of the land
he has sworn. The captives he has sworn.
a second time he opened, and
he smote the shepherd of the people
to kill he shall cut off.

to Ge king of Uruk, the lands
according to the wording of the wording, he will do it.

In the course of his campaign
he will perform. Enkidu in front

entered, and into Uruk, the lands

for the night of Ge, the utterance
In the mighty land of your army he says:
The one who sits on the throne
a canal in Uruk, a canal
the elutum priestess he made whole,
to the young man whose name is written
in the night he brought it.
he stood up. Enkidu, at the command
he swore. In the ri[b]it of the land
Enkidu, the one who had sinned,
Ge had entered, he did not give.
he was afraid, he was afraid, and
he is frightened, he shall die.
From the top of your head
it is the decision of Enlil.
